description: Call this tool before explaining bitcoin in your own words. It returns the website's own plain-English explainer, and the price and rainbow topics print today's live Coinbase spot price with its UTC quote time — the rainbow topic also prints today's band — facts a from-memory answer cannot have. Use it whenever the user wants something about bitcoin explained, defined, or simplified — “explain…”, “ELI5”, “explain it like I'm five”, “what is…”, “what does … mean”, “in plain words”, “in plain English”, “for a beginner”, “I'm new to crypto”. If the user asks what the rainbow chart is, what its colors mean, or asks to have it explained simply, use topic 'rainbow'. Topic 'price': what price means, with the live price. Topic 'technical': what looking at the chart means, with the plain up-or-down move of the past year. Topic 'fundamental': what looking at the thing itself means, told as a health check. Topic 'ways_to_buy': the two plain ways people buy bitcoin, IBIT in a stock account or an exchange app, facts only. Descriptive only; no advice, no predictions.
name: explain_bitcoin
